title: Junior Rangers: Nature Investigators
blurb: Join our Rangers for the first program in this winter's Junior Rangers series. Become a nature investigator as we search for tracks, scat, feathers, and other clues animals leave behind. Through hands-on activities, games, and a short, guided walk, Junior Rangers will practice basic wildlife-tracking skills and discover how to use signs in nature to learn which animals have been nearby and what they've been up to. Attend three Junior Ranger programs to earn your Junior Ranger badge or join us for one or two programs to learn new outdoor skills and spend time with our awesome Rangers. title: Amphibians of Indian Valley
blurb: Join us for an exciting opportunity to observe amphibians in action! We will have a viewing scope set up at the seasonal pools along Indian Valley Fire Road for visitors to enjoy. While many of these rain-loving creatures can be seen with the naked eye, this event offers a chance to get a close look at amphibians in their natural habitat. All ages are welcome. Friendly dogs are allowed but must be kept on a leash. Extreme weather and flooding may cause cancellation. For current information on storm and road impacts, visit emergency.marincounty.gov . Check the calendar or call (415) 473-2816 two hours before the event to confirm. Questions: Alec Guerin

title: Junior Rangers: Watershed Wonders
blurb: Join our Rangers for the second program in this winter's Junior Rangers series. Explore the watershed and discover the incredible journey of our local salmonids. Through hands-on activities, games, and a short, guided walk, Junior Rangers will learn about the salmon life cycle, explore what makes a healthy creek habitat, and discover how everything in a watershed is connected, from the surrounding forest to the streams that salmon call home. Attend three Junior Ranger programs to earn your Junior Ranger badge, or join us for one or two programs to learn new outdoor skills and spend time with our awesome Rangers.
